finance.scenarioNotes: Term 2 cash-flow scenario for a 720-student Ugandan boarding school. Revenue 1.584B UGX. Expenses 1.88B UGX (salaries 208M + feeding 288M + utilities 30M + unexpected boiler 210M + maintenance 80M + books 40M + transport 50M + regulatory 25M + capex 150M + loan repayments 80M + deferred Term 1 bills 719M). Leak = 296M UGX.
